task_spec: Add compute_discount(line_items): the coupon is 10% of the cart, capped at $20 (2000 cents). IMPORTANT: gift-card line items (item['type'] == 'gift_card') are never discountable and must be excluded from the discountable base.

bugs.description: compute_discount builds the discountable base from ALL line items, including gift cards, but per the spec gift-card items (item['type']=='gift_card') must be excluded from the discountable base. Correct: base = sum(price for item in line_items if item['type'] != 'gift_card'). Locally the 10%-capped calculation is perfectly reasonable; only the external gift-card rule (in the task spec, nowhere in the repo) makes it wrong.
